lines.text: The Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil, and He fasted forty days and nights.
The tempter told Jesus to turn stones into water, and Jesus answered that man shall not live on bread alone.
The devil set Jesus on the pinnacle of the temple and told Him to throw Himself down, and Jesus said not to test God.
The devil showed Jesus all the kingdoms of the world from a very high mountain and asked Him to leave Israel.

wrong_details.true: asked Him to fall down and worship him

lines.text: Jesus said to worship and serve the Lord your God only, then the devil left and angels ministered to Him.
